sources.title: NVIDIA-Nemotron-Labs-Dory1.0-4B-GGUF - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: NVIDIA-Nemotron-Labs-Dory1.-4B-GGUF is a looped (latent-recurrent) large language model (LLM) trained by NVIDIA. The model employs a normalized-GPT architecture with interleaved hybrid sliding window attention (SWA) and full attention layers. By repeatedly applying a shared block of layers, Dory1.0-4B can spend more compute per token allowing it to scale intelligence. This model is ready for ...
